kits.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Field Kit
kits.parentNote: Use the measurement log first, then let the story grow from one real or imagined observation.
kits.classroomExtension: Pairs compare two tide notes, mark which details are evidence, and write one shared ending choice.
kits.upsell: Seasonal homeschool bundle adds pond, rain, and compost field notebook quests with matching observation pages.

kits.title: Greenhouse Gear Classroom Pack
kits.parentNote: Best for writers who like making diagrams before drafting; start with the gear redesign sheet.
kits.classroomExtension: Groups assign engineer, gardener, note keeper, and reader roles before presenting one revised greenhouse schedule.
kits.upsell: Class license expansion adds ten more garden engineering prompts, editable rubrics, and substitute-ready lesson notes.

kits.title: Pantry Measurement Mini Kit
kits.parentNote: Keep the task short by asking for three strong sentences on each page instead of a full story at once.
kits.classroomExtension: Students sort recipe details into measurement, time, and observation columns before drafting their pantry explanation.
kits.upsell: Kitchen science bundle adds solar oven, orchard pulley, and recipe revision quests for a four-week writing unit.
